rows.grounds: numeral element forming the count eighty-four thousand
locative plural indicating the large number in which torment occurs
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (mechanism/diagram) denoting realms or devices of birth
past passive participle describing beings subjected to suffering

items.question: Within what vast multitude of yonic mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The count specified is eighty-four thousand.
These thousands are identified as yoni-yantras, mechanisms or realms of birth.
Beings within them are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings undergo torment across an immense array of eighty-four thousand yonic mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
